title: Addressing data indices selected by a set
statement: For a natural number $m$ and a set $J$ of coordinates in the finite index set of size $m+2^m$, define the selected data indices to be those $j\in\{0,\ldots,2^m-1\}$ whose addressing data coordinate belongs to $J$.
